description: Cisco IOS / IOS-XE / NX-OS data points. Three primary access methods: SSH show commands, SNMP CISCO-* MIBs, and NETCONF/RESTCONF on newer platforms.

data_points.name: show version
data_points.description: IOS version, hostname, uptime, image file, model, serial. Cornerstone command for any Cisco discovery.
data_points.typical_ci: cmdb_ci_ip_router / cmdb_ci_ip_switch: name, os_version, model_id, serial_number, uptime

data_points.name: show inventory
data_points.description: Hardware inventory — chassis, modules, line cards, transceivers. Each row has Name/Description/PID/VID/SN.

data_points.name: show interfaces
data_points.description: All interfaces with status, MAC, IP, MTU, bandwidth, input/output errors.

data_points.name: show running-config
data_points.description: Complete running configuration — used for config archival and detailed feature discovery.

data_points.name: show cdp neighbors detail
data_points.description: Cisco Discovery Protocol neighbor info — used for L2 topology discovery (peer device, port, IP, platform).

data_points.name: show lldp neighbors detail
data_points.description: LLDP neighbor info — vendor-neutral L2 discovery.

data_points.name: show ip route
data_points.description: Routing table — used for L3 topology, default gateway, BGP/OSPF peers.

data_points.name: show ip arp
data_points.description: ARP table — IP↔MAC mappings learned by the device.

data_points.name: show ip bgp summary
data_points.description: BGP neighbor state + AS number for each peer.

data_points.name: SNMPv2-MIB::sysDescr
data_points.description: Generic system description — first thing any SNMP-only Cisco discovery hits. Format: 'Cisco IOS Software, ...'.

data_points.name: ENTITY-MIB::entPhysicalTable
data_points.description: Hardware tree (chassis → slots → modules → ports). Vendor-neutral inventory.

data_points.name: CISCO-CDP-MIB::cdpCacheTable
data_points.description: CDP neighbor data via SNMP. OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.9.9.23.1.2.1.

data_points.name: CISCO-MEMORY-POOL-MIB::ciscoMemoryPoolTable
data_points.description: Memory pool utilization (IOS uses processor + I/O pools).
